run_partition_tests: run the FAISS partition unit tests for float32 max and min partitioning across SIMD levels
run_uint16_partition_tests: run the FAISS partition unit tests for uint16 max and min partitioning across SIMD levels
run_histogram_tests: run the FAISS SIMD histogram unit tests for 8-bin and 16-bin bounded and unbounded cases
test_CMax_float_partition_fuzzy: test the CMax_float_partition_fuzzy function to partition float32 arrays by value with fuzzy quantile bounds
test_simd_histogram: test the simd_histogram_8 and simd_histogram_16 functions to compute SIMD-accelerated histograms on uint16 aligned tables
